paragraphs: Chapter 1061
Episode 251. The Great Adversaries (11)

June 10, 1804, it has been about a week since Lucy joined the alliance. At first, she seemed overwhelmed by her new relationships, but thanks to old colleagues like Liet, Murakan, and Veil, she now appears to have adapted well to the alliance.
"The reason I came here now is to cherish her, Strawberry Pie."
"Wow, so cool!"
"To love!"
"That's why!"
"Strawberry Pie!"
Hahahahaha!
Led by Elliot, who first recited in a strange accent, the Plutonian were busy teasing Murakan.
From the day Murakan and Gilli officially became lovers, teasing Murakan became the greatest joy for Elliot and the Plutonian.
In fact, it was a joy for everyone except Murakan, though not many had the courage to laugh in front of Murakan like the Plutonian.
"Ah, these guys are at it again. Hey, hey! Aren't you standing there!? Just die, come here! With Ban protecting, you act like you can't see? Won't stop!"
"Kyakyakyakya!"
"Kyahaha, ack!"
Several fleeing warriors and common soldiers were soon caught by Murakan, their jaws turned. However, the Plutonian kept teasing Murakan even while being hit.
"Just die, really, just die!"
"But it's true what Murakan's friend confessed!"
"Jin, your brothers are truly a warrior race, getting hit by Murakan's fists like that and the bruises heal in a few hours."
"It's amazing. I also pride myself on having a quite sturdy body, but being hit like that would surely cause serious injury."
"Still, if you look closely, Murakan knows how to respect the elderly. Every time it starts with Elliot, he doesn't hit him."
"That's true."
Veradin and Dante were watching. Jin shrugged.
"Right. Murakan does have a sense of hierarchy."
"By the way, Jin, are you really okay with Gilli and Murakan becoming lovers?"
"There's nothing to be okay or not, Veradin. It feels a bit odd, but it was bound to happen."
Jin had never seen Gilli smile as often as she does now. Murakan, except when beating up his teasing comrades, was always smiling.
"Seeing them makes me want to be in love."
At Veradin's words, Jin and Dante swallowed a bitter smile.

They knew he was saying things he didn't mean, trying to shake off his depression. Veradin had been cheerful since being rescued, but in reality, he suffered every day. He was haunted by the terrible things he had done under mind control.
He couldn't possibly want to be in love. He wanted to throw himself into making up for his past sins as soon as possible.

"Ah, what kind of love can a sinner like me seek? This empty heart and sadness... From now on, I will transform all into anger to fight against the enemy! In that sense, is there a place for me in the Golden Fleet? Since I was a bad guy, not in a grand position like a fleet admiral or captain, but just as an ordinary crew member."
Veradin said, looking out the window.

Outside the window, the newly constructed golden ships from last night were visible. Currently, over three hundred golden ships were floating in the seas near the Tikan Palace, looking like clouds made of melted gold flowing across the sky. All the people of Tikan were outside, admiring this magnificent sight.
Jin pulled out a shoulder strap from his pocket and handed it to Veradin.
"This is the shoulder strap of the ninth fleet admiral of the Barmul Alliance, Tikan Nation. The fleet's name is Drakka."
"Drakka!?"

Drakka was the capital of the Lutero Magic Federation, which disappeared a few months ago due to the Red Plutonian attack. Along with the Tower of Story, Drakka had been a symbol of Ziffle for a long time.
"If you name the golden fleet that!"
"Veradin, the you I remember was the most righteous person in the Ziffle. Among those who were not like people, you were like a person."
Before Jin's regression, Veradin was widely known as a strong and righteous figure.
And after the regression, the Veradin that Jin directly experienced was the same. Until the mind control, he was indeed the most righteous person in the Ziffle.

"During the Holy Kingdom incident, you were outraged to see your family trying to starve the citizens of the Holy Kingdom to death. It was right after Ziffle had passed gold bars to the Holy Kingdom through coercion. That's why you set fire to the gold bars yourself. Do you remember what you said to us in your villa after that incident? You said you would turn Ziffle around."
- Even if it wasn't for you, Runkandel and Ziffle would have fought."

- That's true, but Jin. I feel responsible in my own way. If my family is going down the wrong path, shouldn't I correct it? I'll normalize everything. I'll turn Ziffle back into the proud family I knew it to be."
It was a memory Veradin did not wish to forget for even a moment. Excluding the period when he had become a monster due to mind manipulation, Veradin had always cherished the memories of that day.

"In my view, those words still hold true. Of course, our alliance plans to annihilate Ziffle from now on, but you are an exception. When the name Ziffle ceases to exist in this world, that's when you should rebuild Drakka. As the most righteous person from Ziffle. That's the significance behind the name given."
Veradin looked at Jin for a long time before accepting the shoulder strap.

"Well, excluding the fact that its rulers were indeed scumbags, Drakka was the best city to live in. For the ordinary people who lived there, their homes and homeland have now disappeared. Alright, I'll take on the role of captain. It's hard to refuse when the supreme commander himself asks."
"It's not a request, it's an order."
"You sure are strict with friends. Isn't it a bit annoying, Dante?"
"To me, this is a heartwarming scene."
"Anyway, I will rebuild Drakka someday as commanded, Supreme Commander. And it's not just me; there's Sandra and Betty, the not-scumbag Ziffles. Of course, neither of them is without sin like me."
"I've already assigned those two to the 9th Fleet."
"You're thorough. What about the Immortal? Is he also part of our fleet?"
"Immortal is assigned to the Runkandel fleet. He's one of the Ten Knights, so it's only natural."
"Well, Immortal might be treated like a fool here, but in the Garden of Swords, he's practically a living myth."
The three of them chuckled senselessly. Murakan was still being teased in the distance, and Lucy was barely holding back her laughter at the scene.

"Speaking of which, Jin, Lucy is quite impressive. If you're going to laugh, just laugh. I heard her situation is similar to mine; should I offer some advice? Or, is it a bit awkward since I'm from Ziffle? Ah, what does it matter? She's trapped in the thought that she shouldn't laugh because she's a bad person."
Before Jin could reply, Veradin approached Lucy. As soon as Veradin spoke to her, Lucy reflexively swung her fist, knocking Veradin out for about 5 seconds before he got up.
"Sorry. I know Veradin isn't bad, but I couldn't help it when I heard the word Ziffle."

"No worries, Lucy. It's alright. If it's hard to smile, then feel free to beat me up instead. It's better than being crushed under guilt and unable to fight properly. But seeing as you swing your fist at the mention of Ziffle, it seems I don't need to worry."
Lucy attempted to reply but ended up releasing an awkward laugh, ha, ha, ha. That in itself was progress.
Jin and Dante chuckled at the scene.
"Let's make sure not to push her too hard. She has a lot to do once the fight is over, so she needs to survive."
"Of course."
Jin pulled out a pocket watch. It was nearing noon.
"Almost noon."
As Jin stood up and started walking, all the nearby comrades began to follow him one by one.
Jin was headed to the aerial garden of Tikan Palace.
As he and the officers ascended to the aerial garden, all the golden ships floating nearby began to form a line.
By the time Jin reached the aerial garden, all the fleets of Tikan were arrayed in front of him in a single line. Of all the golden fleets of Tikan produced so far, only one was not present.
The Divine Fleet, with Ban as captain.
They had been tracking the Tower of Story with Valeria for the past week and had contacted Jin for the first time an hour ago.
The Tower of Story, Ziffle's current location, could be pinpointed, and they requested half of the currently operational golden ships to assemble by noon for support.
The sortie preparations had already been completed well in advance. They were just waiting for noon.
Creeeak!

A giant steel door opened behind the lined-up golden fleet in the sky, and hundreds of flying ships led by Kinzelo's flagship Grugnil emerged from the steel door. Half of Kinzelo's fleet of three hundred ships were regular flying ships, and the other half were the black fleet of the Abyss Legion.
Orgal was grinding his teeth on the prow of Grugnil. It was the first time since learning the truth of the world that they were about to strike at Ziffle.
"I would have left without you if you were late, Orgal."

[As if you'd do that. You know as well as I do that there's no ally more reliable for you guys than us Kinzelo. By the way, your lover and Ban are quite something. To have caught their tail already. I was surprised when I got the communication.]
In a way, it was a gathering of Ziffle's greatest adversaries.
Just then, as the pocket watch pointed exactly to noon, Jin's communicator vibrated. It was a communication from the Divine Fleet.
{It's confirmed, Jin. It's above the center of the Sota Desert. Just come over with a spatial leap.}
After hearing Valeria's voice, Jin immediately boarded the ship at the very center of the fleet's formation.
The ship, sharp as a sword, contained a power greater than any golden ship produced thus far.
It was Runkandel's first flagship, 'Sara'.
